options.label: 自然站立
options.value: stands naturally with a relaxed posture, looking effortless.

options.label: 叉腰自信
options.value: stands confidently with both hands on their hips, chest puffed out.

options.label: 回头望
options.value: looking back over their shoulder with a subtle body twist, making eye contact.

options.label: 背手
options.value: stands with hands clasped behind their back, leaning forward slightly with curiosity.

options.label: 单腿站立 (偶像感)
options.value: stands on one leg in a lively idol pose, balancing energetically.

options.label: 靠墙站立
options.value: leans casually against a wall with arms crossed, looking cool.

options.label: 内八字 (害羞)
options.value: stands pigeon-toed with knees touching, looking shy and timid.

options.label: 正坐 (跪坐)
options.value: sits formally on their knees in a seiza position, with hands resting neatly on their lap.

options.label: 抱膝坐
options.value: sits on the floor hugging their knees, curled up in a small ball.

options.label: 鸭子坐 (W坐)
options.value: sits on the floor in a W-shaped pose (duck sitting), looking cute and flexible.

options.label: 跷二郎腿 (女王)
options.value: sits on a chair with legs crossed, looking down with an arrogant and dominant vibe.

options.label: 侧身坐
options.value: sits on the floor with legs swept to one side, looking elegant.

options.label: 抱腿悬空
options.value: floats in mid-air, hugging their legs as if in zero gravity.

options.label: 俯卧翘脚
options.value: lies on their stomach, propped up on elbows, with lower legs bent upwards playfully.

options.label: 蜷缩侧卧
options.value: lies curled up on their side in a fetal position, looking vulnerable or asleep.

options.label: 仰卧伸手
options.value: lies on their back reaching one hand up towards the sky, viewed from above.

options.label: 大字躺
options.value: lies flat on their back with arms and legs spread out, looking completely exhausted or relaxed.

options.label: 比耶 (双剪刀手)
options.value: makes double peace signs with both hands near their face, smiling brightly.

options.label: 比心
options.value: makes a heart shape with their fingers, holding it near their chest or face.

options.label: 伸出手 (邀请)
options.value: reaches one hand out towards the viewer as if inviting them to come closer.

options.label: 托腮思考
options.value: rests their chin on their hand, looking lost in thought or bored.

options.label: 食指抵唇 (嘘)
options.value: places an index finger on their lips in a shushing gesture, implying a secret.

options.label: 撩头发
options.value: gently tucks a strand of hair behind their ear, looking attractive.

options.label: 奔跑
options.value: running fast, leaning forward with dynamic motion.

options.label: 跃起
options.value: jumping high into the air, captured in a dynamic mid-air pose.

options.label: 战斗架势
options.value: assumes a combat stance, body tense and ready to fight.

options.label: 高踢腿
options.value: performs a high kick, leg extended straight up in a martial arts move.

options.label: 拔刀/蓄力
options.value: crouches low with a hand on their weapon, preparing to strike.

options.label: 施法
options.value: stretches arms out casting a spell, surrounded by magical energy.

options.label: 中二病姿势
options.value: strikes an exaggerated, dramatic pose inspired by anime style.

options.label: 猫娘姿势
options.value: poses like a cat, curling their hands like paws.

options.label: 僵尸/失神
options.value: stands with arms hanging loosely and a blank expression, like a zombie.

options.label: 傲娇扭头
options.value: turns their head away with arms crossed and a hmph expression.
